newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SOCCER-CAF HAND UGANDANS A WALKOVER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CAF HAND UGANDANS A WALKOVER.

text.p: The Confederation of African Football (CAF) said on Wednesday it had handed Ugandan cup winners Umeme SC a walkover into round two of the African Cup Winners' Cup by disqualifying their Cameroonian opponents.
Racing Bafooussam were kicked out of this year's tournament after arriving a day late for their scheduled first round first leg match in Kampala in March.
Umeme refused to play the game, claiming a walkover because their opponents had failed to arrive at the stipulated time. Their decision was upheld this week by CAF's competitions committee.
The Ugandan team will meet Algeria's Mouloudia Oran in the second round next weekend.
